When driving, you tend not to get motion sick, compared to back seat passengers , which, according to research, is perhaps because I can anticipate the movement of the car.

questions.question: What do you usually do when there is a traffic jam?
questions.answer: Well, if I'm stuck in a traffic jam, my first reaction is often to get restless. You know, I start complaining and keep looking out of the window to estimate how long I'll have to wait. Though once I manage to calm down, I like to play some soft music or play games on my phone.

questions.question: What kinds of websites do you often visit?
questions.answer: I often use search engines like Baidu and Google. I frequently visit these two sites especially when I need to learn something new. Such websites can provide me with the best matched information I need. For instance, if I need to know more about art history, I can search on Google and browse pages of information. When I need to get the latest news, I can also sort by date, or search for news pages. As a result, I often use these websites.

questions.question: What is your favourite website?
questions.answer: Whenever possible, I would access Youtube. It harbors probably the richest categories of videos among all websites alike. You know, I am always on the way teaching myself new things, improving myself. Youtube just has the right materials to help me. Initially, I logged on to it to watch TED videos. Those great speeches given by specialists were so inspiring. Then gradually, I found tons of high-quality videos. I learned to match clothes by watching fashion videos on Youtube, and also my knowledge was expanded in psychology, astronomy, science and etc. I drew so much nutrition from Youtube videos.

questions.question: Are there any changes to the websites you ofter visit？
questions.answer: I find that search engines like Baidu and Google become smarter nowadays. For instance, if you search COVID-19 related information on both websites, they will advise you to go to the hospital as soon as possible and provide the latest data on COVID-19 cases. Moreover, these websites now have a special tag for the advertising web pages so that we users won’t get misled by these advertising pages, which is a great improvement.

questions.question: What kinds of websites are popular in your country?
questions.answer: As you may know, TikTok is widespread in China these days, so I think the most popular websites would be those with short videos. What’s more, online shopping websites are also gaining popularity. It's shocking that China's online avenue on November 11th surpassed that of America's largest retail store for the whole year.

questions.question: Would you use mirrors to decorate your room?
questions.answer: I don’t think it’s a good idea to fill my room with mirrors, really. In my culture, mirrors aren’t lucky emblems. I remember my grandmother used to tell me horror stories, where mirrors can call through a ghost at night. So, for that reason alone, I would never use mirrors to light up my place.

questions.question: Do you usually take a mirror with you ?
questions.answer: I carry a mini mirror in my bag wherever I go. To be honest, I started keeping a mirror on me when I was a teenager. I use it to check if my teeth are clean after eating, and whether I need to fix up my make-up. I’d feel so insecure without it.

questions.question: Have you ever bought mirrors?
questions.answer: Well, yes. I’ve bought many mirrors since I realized the huge benefit of them. Funnily enough, now you mention it, I bought a really expensive one only a couple of weeks ago, which was advertised to reflect the perfect image of your make up.

questions.question: Do you like looking at yourself in the mirror?How often?
questions.answer: I’d say yes. I mean, I check my make-up in the mirror many times a day. It always boosts my confidence when my reflection looks awesome , because it makes me feel confident.

questions.question: Do you prefer to watch films at home or in the cinema?
questions.answer: I prefer watching at home because it’s more comfortable and flexible. I can pause, rewind, and eat whatever I want. But for big visual effects movies like sci-fi or action, the cinema is definitely better.

questions.question: How often do you watch films?
questions.answer: On average, I watch about one or two films per week. Sometimes more if I’m on holiday, sometimes less if I’m busy with exams. I try to keep it balanced so that it doesn’t affect my study time.

questions.question: Do you think going to the cinema is a good way to spend time with friends?
questions.answer: Yes, I’d say so. It’s a low-pressure activity — you don’t need to keep a conversation going the whole time. After the movie, you can grab a snack and talk about your favorite scenes. It’s simple but enjoyable.

questions.question: Do you often go to the cinema with your friends?
questions.answer: It depends. When we’re all free, yes. But with busy schedules, it’s not that often — maybe once every two months. We usually choose a comedy or an action film because those work best for a group.

questions.question: Did you ever go to the cinema alone as a child?
questions.answer: No, never. As a child, I always went with my parents or older cousins. My parents wouldn’t allow me to go alone because they thought it was unsafe. Looking back, I think they were right.

questions.question: Did you often watch films when you were a child?
questions.answer: Yes, I watched films quite regularly. My family had a collection of Disney VCDs, so I watched those over and over again. I also remember watching Chinese martial arts films with my dad on weekend afternoons.

questions.question: What films do you like?
questions.answer: I’m a big fan of detective and mystery films. I love trying to solve the puzzle before the ending. Sometimes I also enjoy romantic dramas, but I’m not into superhero movies — they feel a bit repetitive to me.

questions.question: Are there any old buildings you want to see in the future? why?
questions.answer: Yes, I’d like to visit the ancient town of Pingyao in Shanxi. It has well-preserved city walls and traditional banking buildings from the Ming and Qing dynasties. Seeing it would help me understand how people lived centuries ago.

questions.question: Do you prefer living in an old building or a modern house?
questions.answer: I slightly prefer old buildings, actually. I live in one right now — it has high ceilings, thick walls, and lots of character. The only downside is the plumbing. But the charm and quiet atmosphere make up for it.

questions.question: Do you think we should preserve old buildings in cities?
questions.answer: I think so, but selectively. Not every old building is worth keeping. Some have historical or artistic value, while others are just old and unsafe. The government should protect the meaningful ones and replace the rest wisely.

questions.question: Have you ever seen old buildings in the city?
questions.answer: Yes, in many Chinese cities you can find old buildings right next to new ones. For example, in Shanghai, there are old shikumen houses. They look a bit worn but very unique. I think they add character to the city.

questions.question: Have you ever watched a live show?
questions.answer: Yes, I went to a stand-up comedy show last year. It was a lot of fun because the comedian interacted with the audience. The atmosphere was completely different from watching a screen — much more energetic.

questions.question: Do you like to watch comedies?
questions.answer: Yes, I’m a big fan. Comedies are my go-to choice when I want to kill time or cheer up. I prefer romantic comedies or funny family shows. They always put me in a good mood without needing too much brainpower.

questions.question: Do your friends like to tell jokes?
questions.answer: Yes, a few of my friends are natural comedians. They love sharing funny stories or silly puns. It really lifts our mood when we hang out, especially after a long day of studying or working.

questions.question: Are you good at telling jokes?
questions.answer: I’m okay, but not great. I can tell simple and clean jokes, but I’m not a natural storyteller. Sometimes I laugh before finishing the punchline. Still, my friends say I’m quite funny when I’m not trying too hard.

questions.question: Do you still like going to parks now?
questions.answer: Yes, I do, but the reasons have changed. As a child, I went to parks mainly to play on the equipment and run around. Now, I visit parks for peace and relaxation. Living in a busy city, parks offer a quiet escape from traffic and crowds. I enjoy walking along the paths, sitting on a bench to read, or just listening to the birds. It's a great way to reduce stress and recharge. I probably go once or twice a month. So yes, I still like parks, just in a more grown-up way.

questions.question: Did you like going to parks as a child?
questions.answer: Definitely. I have very fond memories of going to parks as a child. There was a small park just a ten- minute walk from my home, and my parents used to take me there almost every weekend. I loved running on the grass, playing on the swings, and feeding the ducks in the pond. It felt like a little escape from school and homework. Looking back, I think those park visits helped me stay active and also gave me a chance to connect with nature. So yes, I absolutely enjoyed it.

questions.question: When did you start using social media?
questions.answer: I began using social media about five years ago, mainly to stay in touch with friends and family living abroad. At first, I only had a simple profile, but over time, I started sharing photos and updates regularly. It’s been a helpful way to keep connected and discover new trends worldwide.

questions.question: Have you ever posted anything on social media?
questions.answer: Yes, I have shared posts on social media several times. Mostly, I upload photos from my travels or special events. It’s a fun way to keep in touch with friends and show them what I’m up to. However, I try not to share too much personal information because privacy is important to me.

questions.question: Do you think you spend too much time on social media?
questions.answer: Honestly, sometimes I feel a little addicted to social media. You know, one minute you're browsing Tik Tok and the next an hour has passed. I've been trying to cut down on my social media use, especially during exams. Well, it's like, I need to keep reminding myself that there is a whole world beyond the screen of my phone.

questions.question: What do people do on social media？
questions.answer: Oh, people do all sorts of things on social media. Some people focus on sharing their daily lives, such as photos, what they're eating, and where they're hanging out. Others are keen on sharing cute moments of their pets. And, of course, there are plenty of people who just like to watch funny videos or keep up with news and trends. I can't really think of anything we can't do on social media.

questions.question: Do your friends use social medial？
questions.answer: Yeah, almost all of my friends use social media. It's our go-to way to stay in touch, especially those of us who have gone to different cities for college or work. We are always messaging each other in WeChat or sharing things on QQ. It's like our virtual hangout. Honestly, I can't imagine a day without that connection.

questions.question: What kind of clothes do you like to wear?
questions.answer: I prefer to wear formal attire for the workplace. This typically includes well-fitted suits, dress shirts, and ties. I believe that dressing professionally not only reflects a sense of responsibility and competence, but also allows for a more confident and respectful demeanor.

questions.question: Do you prefer to wear comfortable and casual clothes or smart clothes?
questions.answer: Personally, I prefer to wear comfortable and casual clothes rather than smart clothes. Casual attire allows me to move freely and focus on my tasks without feeling restricted. Moreover, it helps create a relaxed and friendly atmosphere in the workplace.

questions.question: Do you like wearing T-shirts?
questions.answer: Yes, I do enjoy wearing T-shirts for casual occasions. They are comfortable, versatile, and easy to style. T-shirts are not typically considered appropriate office wear, so I reserve them for my personal time outside of work.

questions.question: Do you spend a lot of time choosing clothes?
questions.answer: I do not spend a lot of time choosing clothes. I believe in keeping things simple and efficient when it comes to dressing for work. I have a basic wardrobe of versatile pieces that can be easily mixed and matched, saving me time and effort in selecting an outfit each day.

questions.question: What city do you live in?
questions.answer: I currently reside in the beautiful coastal city of Qingdao in China. Known for its stunning beaches, delicious seafood, and rich cultural heritage, Qingdao is a vibrant and dynamic city that offers a wonderful quality of life. I am fortunate to call it my home, and I enjoy exploring all that this city has to offer while pursuing my studies.

questions.question: What's the weather like where you live?
questions.answer: The weather where I live can be quite unpredictable. It ranges from scorching heat in the summer to freezing cold in the winter. However, overall, it tends to be mild and comfortable throughout the year. There are occasional rain showers and gusty winds, but it adds to the charm of the place. It's a great place for outdoor activities and enjoying nature's beauty.

questions.question: Are there people of different ages living in this city?
questions.answer: I have observed that there are people of all ages living in my city. From young kids to teenagers, to working-age adults and senior citizens, the population here is diverse and varied. This mix of different generations brings a unique energy to the city, seriously.

questions.question: Is this city your permanent residence?
questions.answer: No, this city is not my permanent residence. I moved here for my studies and will stay until I graduate. However, I do enjoy living in this city because it has a vibrant cultural atmosphere and provides many opportunities for personal and professional growth.

questions.question: Are there big changes in this city?
questions.answer: Yes, there have been some big changes in Qingdao in recent years, especially with the city's rapid development. One of the most notable changes is the expansion of transportation systems, such as the subway and high-speed rail, which has made travel much more convenient.

questions.question: How long have you lived in this city?
questions.answer: I have been living in this city for two years. Even though it hasn't been long, this city has become like a second home to me. I've had the opportunity to explore various areas of the city and discover its hidden gems., and I'm excited to see what else this city has in store for me.

questions.question: Do you like this city? Why?
questions.answer: I absolutely love Qingdao! There are so many things about this city that make it unique and special. The beautiful ocean views, fresh seafood, and friendly locals are just a few reasons why I enjoy living here. Qingdao has offered me a great balance of academics, leisure, and personal growth. It's definitely a city that has captured my heart!

questions.question: Do you often see your neighbors？
questions.answer: Not really, I don't often see my neighbors. We all seem to have busy schedules and rarely have time to interact. However, when we do see each other, we exchange greetings and small talk. It's not like we're close friends, but it's nice to have a sense of community.

questions.question: Are the people friendly in the city？
questions.answer: Yes, the people in the city are incredibly friendly. They are always willing to help and engage in conversation. Whether it's asking for directions or seeking recommendations, they are approachable and kind-hearted. Their warm hospitality creates a welcoming atmosphere which makes living here an enjoyable experience. Interacting with locals has not only broadened my cultural understanding but also made me feel accepted and part of the community.

questions.question: Is the city friendly to children and old people?
questions.answer: Yes, the city is extremely friendly to children and old people. There are numerous parks and playgrounds specifically designed for children, allowing them to play and explore in a safe environment. Additionally, there are various community centers and social clubs dedicated to the elderly, providing them with opportunities for socialization and activities tailored to their needs. The city also prioritizes pedestrian- friendly infrastructure, making it easier for children and the elderly to navigate the streets safely.

questions.question: What do you do in the mornings?
questions.answer: On weekdays, I usually have a routine to get ready for work, including putting on makeup, getting dressed, a quick breakfast and then rush to the bus stop to catch the minibus. On weekend, on the other hand, I tend to sleep in and wake up naturally, around noon usually. And then I will just get a brunch with my roommate.

questions.question: Is breakfast important?
questions.answer: I would say so. Breakfast is sometimes described as the most important meal of the day. And I’ve also heard studies that eating breakfast seems to have a positive effect on weight maintenance. like most people, I am usually hungry when I wake up, sometimes a bite of biscuits or even some juice, which can make me feel so much better.

questions.question: What is your morning routine?
questions.answer: Mornings can be the busiest time of the day and I start to create a fast routine for myself after a few years of working. After I wake up, I get ready for work, including putting on a quick makeup around 10 minutes, get dressed, meanwhile, downing some milk and scarfing a quick breakfast. If I am quick, I will also think about today’s to-do list.

questions.question: Do you like to get up early in the morning?
questions.answer: Like most people, I am not a morning person. I find waken up by an alarm clock very stressful and a bad morning impacts the whole day. If I were to choose, I always prefer to get up naturally. However, the reality was and still is, I always have to get up pretty early, for lessons or work.

questions.question: Do you have a favorite teacher?
questions.answer: Yes, I do have a favorite teacher. In particular, my Chinese language teacher holds a special place in my heart. Her name is Ms. Li, and she has been my teacher for the past three years. What makes her unique is her passion for teaching and her commitment to helping her students succeed. She always goes the extra mile to make her classes engaging and interactive, using various teaching methods and incorporating real- life examples. I appreciate her patience and dedication in ensuring that each student understands the content thoroughly.

questions.question: In what way has your favourite teacher helped you?
questions.answer: My favorite teacher has greatly helped me in developing my thinking skills and organizing my daily tasks effectively. Through thought-provoking discussions and challenging assignments, she taught me how to critically analyze information and approach problems from different perspectives. Additionally, she guided me in setting realistic goals and creating a structured schedule to prioritize my tasks. As a result, I have become more efficient in managing my time and accomplishing my daily responsibilities.

questions.question: Do you have a teacher from your past that you still remember?
questions.answer: Yes, I do have a teacher from my past that I still remember vividly. Her name is Ms. Wang, my Chinese language teacher in primary school. What makes her unforgettable is her incredible patience towards me. Whenever I struggled with a concept or had difficulty understanding a lesson, she would patiently explain it to me until I grasped the concept. Her patience was truly remarkable and it made a significant impact on my learning experience. Ms. Wang's dedication and commitment to her students left a lasting impression on me and I will always be grateful for her guidance.

questions.question: Are you still in touch with your primary school teachers?
questions.answer: No, I am not currently in touch with my primary school teachers. Unfortunately, I do not have any means of contacting them. However, I do hope to reconnect with them in the future if I am able to find a way to get in touch. It would be wonderful to catch up with them and reminisce about my time in primary school.

questions.question: Do you want to be a teacher in the future?
questions.answer: Yeah, well, I don’t mind teaching. To a point, I think teaching is the most rewarding job in the world. Because you are cultivating the next generation for this society. Your devotion will be paid off in the future. So yeah, if I am qualified to be a teacher, I will make it my career.

questions.question: In what conditions, you won't use headphones？
questions.answer: I never use the headphones when I’m in the car, or on a plane. ‘cause I feel that there’s already enough noise from the vehicle running, my ears really can’t afford any more of that. As much as I love to enjoy music, I do worry about my hearing safety.

questions.question: When would you use headphones？
questions.answer: I use them when I want to enjoy some good music. You know, with the headphones, I can get better solid quality of the sound. And also, when I’m having online classes, I need the headphones, ‘cause then they help me focus on the class content, rather than being distracted by the outside noise.

questions.question: Do you use headphones？
questions.answer: People are more reliant on headphones nowadays, and I am no exception. In my spare time, I love to enjoy some quiet time by putting in my headphones and playing some of my favorite music. During work, they’re always in my ears, because I need to receive many phone calls every day, and in order to be more efficient, I like to communicate via headphones rather than typing emails.

questions.question: What kind of headphones do you use？
questions.answer: Among all the headphones on the market, I prefer to use Bluetooth headsets, which connect to mobile phones via Bluetooth instead of a cable, making them extremely free and easy to use. This also makes them much more comfortable to wear than a wired headset.

questions.question: When was the last time you read about history?
questions.answer: Well, you know, I don't major in history and I’m not really into that area, so it might be a few years ago when I read some. At the time, I was in high school and was preparing for an important history exam. From that learning, I got to know how our country was founded and how much effort the leaders had put into it.

questions.question: Have you ever been to history museums?
questions.answer: To be honest, I don't think I’ve been to any sorts of history museum. I have visited some art or science museums, but history, I don't think so. I’ve always wanted to pay a visit to a history museum because I reckon that there will be lots of thought-provoking facts to learn about.

questions.question: Did you like history when you were young?
questions.answer: Actually, I guess I did have a period when I was quite into the stories of the past. I believe that was at the age of 5 or 6, when my grandpa was living with me. He told me a lot of fascinating stories about the old days in a really dramatic way. I was totally engrossed with history at the time.

questions.question: Do you like history?
questions.answer: Well, I believe I have very neutral attitudes towards history. I mean I don't really like it but I don't detest it either. I think it’s probably because I’m convinced that history itself is really intriguing and we can learn a great deal from it, but my history teachers back in school were quite boring so I don't really have a positive impression of it.

questions.question: Do you prefer online shopping or in-store shopping？
questions.answer: It depends on what I'm buying. For everyday items like books, electronics, or household goods, I definitely prefer online shopping because it's time-saving and often cheaper. I can compare prices easily and read reviews from other customers. However, when it comes to clothes, shoes, or furniture, I prefer going to a physical store. I want to see the quality, try things on, or test the product before making a decision. So I'd say I use both, depending on the situation.

questions.question: How often do you go shopping？
questions.answer: I wouldn't say I shop very often. For essentials like food and household items, I go to the supermarket roughly twice a week. As for clothes, shoes, or electronics, I only shop when necessary — maybe once a month or even less. I'm not really into window shopping or browsing for fun because I find it a bit tiring and time-consuming. So overall, I'd describe myself as a practical shopper who buys things only when needed.

questions.question: Do you like shopping?
questions.answer: I like shopping. I mean shopping is a great way to relieve stress as long as you don’t overdo it. Also, because you often shop with friends, it’s a great chance for you to connect with one another by creating shared memories. Moreover, putting on beautiful and stylish clothes will actually make you feel good about yourself, thus boosting one’s self-confidence.

questions.question: Did you use to keep your room tidy as a child？
questions.answer: To be honest, I was quite a messy child. I rarely kept my room tidy because I was too busy playing or watching cartoons. My desk was usually covered with schoolbooks, toys, and snack wrappers. My parents often reminded me to clean up, but I would just push things under the bed or into the closet. Looking back, I think I was just lazy, but as I grew older, I gradually learned to be more organized.

questions.question: Do you like to keep things tidy？
questions.answer: Yes, definitely. I'm someone who really appreciates a clean and organized space. I find that when my surroundings are tidy, I feel calmer and more productive. I usually make my bed every morning and put things back in their place after using them. That said, I'm not obsessive about it. If I'm busy with exams or projects, I might let things slide for a few days, but I always tidy up afterwards. So yes, I do like keeping things tidy.

questions.question: Do Chinese people often visit science museums?
questions.answer: I'm not sure if the majority Chinese are interested in the science museums. You see, most Chinese parents would like to cultivate their children's interest in science. So they may pay to send their children to these museums, but for themselves, I'm afraid they would rather spend their spare time somewhere else, like a theater, rather than visiting museums.

questions.question: Do you like watching science TV programs?
questions.answer: Yep! I like to watch science documentaries, especially those that explore the secrets in the universe. Actually there is a science program sponsored by Nasa in America. I watch that regularly. Sometimes I would even invite friends over to enjoy the show together.

questions.question: What kinds of interesting things you have done with science?
questions.answer: I used to do an experiment related to nutrition on myself. I was curious about the impacts of carb on human body, so I decided to stop taking in carbs for a week to see if there are any changes on my body. I felt tired and anxious on the fourth day after stopping eating carbs and felt a bit dizzy on the fifth day. So, I stopped the experiment on the sixth day because I felt really bad.

questions.question: Which science subject is interesting to you?
questions.answer: I like biology the most. We started to learn biology in the middle school. Because I am very into human bodies, I am deeply attracted to how human body functions which is a core part in biology. I am obsessed with how cells work with each other to become organs, blood and many other important parts in our body.

questions.question: When did you start to learn about science？
questions.answer: I started to learn about science since I was 10. At that time, I was in grade 4 in primary school and I took a class called “science”. In that course, we did a lot of physics experiments including paper planes, mini- rocket and so on. I did not know that was physics knowledge but I felt that it was pretty interesting and willing to learn more in the future. Well, my experience with science began as a child because my father and mother both had scientific interests. When I was a kid, we had lots of books about astronomy, physics and nature, so my interest in science was established by reading those books and hearing my parents discuss it all the time.

questions.question: Do you like science?
questions.answer: Of course, I do, when I was a little kid, my parents took me to many stunning science museums and galleries, which really broadened my horizons. Also, science provided me a deeper understanding of the earth. Yes, I do, if I remember correctly, I fell in love with it in an early age. I always have a lively curiosity(强 烈的好奇心) about things, and thanks to science books, I learned a lot about the natural phenomena and the laws of science.

questions.question: Do you like singing? Why or why not?
questions.answer: Absolutely! Although I’m not a professional singer and not very talented in that respect, I’m still very into singing, especially when I’m taking a shower. The echo of my voice in the shower cubicle always sounds better than elsewhere, so I often hum to myself in the bathroom with my Bluetooth speaker on.

questions.question: Have you ever learnt how to sing?
questions.answer: No, not really. Throughout my entire school years, I never really had a real music lesson. The school I went to focused only on the academic side. At school, singing wasn't really a priority, so I never had the chance to learn it seriously. But I used to I used to teach myself some singing skills through videos on the Internet.

questions.question: Who do you want to sing for?
questions.answer: Ah, that’s a tricky question for me. Normally I only sing to myself, cause I’m such a terrible singer. But perhaps I can sing for my parents on their birthdays. They certainly wouldn’t laugh at my bad singing, but they are the only people I would sing for, cause I love them so much.

questions.question: Do you think singing can bring happiness to people?
questions.answer: Perhaps. I have a lot of friends who enjoy singing! They pay to go to KTVs to sing. They throw themselves into music and seem to be completely involved in their singing. So I think singing must bring them pleasure and comfort in some ways. Yeah, so they must find some sort of happiness in singing.

questions.question: Do you like modern art or traditional art?
questions.answer: Compared with traditional art, I prefer modern art. Of course, this does not mean that traditional art is unappealing. Traditional art gives people the enjoyment of eternal beauty, and there is a reason why these beautiful treasures have been handed down through the years. But modern art has a stronger visual impact, which makes more of an impression on me.

questions.question: Do you want to be an artist?
questions.answer: Well, to be honest, although I love art, I don’t think I would like to be an artist in the future. I know that my grandfather’s paintings can be sold for a lot of money, but he was relatively poor when he was younger when he was a nobody. For most artists, they lead a relatively poor life . So, I don’t want to be an artist.

questions.question: Do you like visiting art galleries?
questions.answer: Of course, I like visiting art galleries. My grandfather always brought me to different art galleries when I was young. Even now, sometimes I go with him to art galleries. My favorite art gallery is the Louvre in Paris, France. I have been there once, before the epidemic started, and it was breathtaking. I still remember the excitement I felt when I saw the Mona Lisa for the first time.

questions.question: Do you like art?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. I like all kinds of art. I think I got influenced by my grandfather. My grandfather is a well- known local oil painter. One of his oil paintings can be sold for a few thousand dollars. When I was young, I always watched him paint. Then gradually I fell in love with the arts. Not only paintings and drawings, I am also a big fan of musical instruments.

questions.question: Does happy music make you feel more excited？
questions.answer: Yes, happy music often lifts my mood and energizes me. For example, upbeat songs with a fast tempo can make me feel more enthusiastic and motivated, especially when I’m exercising or socializing. However, sometimes I prefer calm music to relax rather than increase excitement, depending on the situation.

questions.question: Do you prefer sad or happy music？
questions.answer: I usually prefer happy music because it lifts my mood and energizes me, especially after a long day. However, sometimes I enjoy sad songs as well since they allow me to reflect on my feelings and experience a sense of calm. Overall, my choice depends on my current emotional state and the situation I’m in.

questions.question: Do you want to know more about outer space?
questions.answer: Yeah, you know when I was a kid, I always wanted to see what the Earth looked like from far away, or whether there would be aliens on other planets. All these things sound pretty interesting for someone like me who really wants to explore the unknown in the solar system (太阳系), or even the whole universe. However, the way I’ve learnt about outer space is kinda limited to sci-fi movies, documentaries, and some famous books.

questions.question: Do you want to go into outer space in the future?
questions.answer: Well, I am negative about the commercial availability of space travel in my lifetime. But if the chance is real, I would certainly give it a go. Outer space is full of mystery, and discovering the unknown is always something worth human effort. Let’s just hope for rapid technological advancement.

questions.question: Do you like science fiction movies?Why?
questions.answer: I do. A number of the most distinguished films in the film industry set their background on space travel . I surely enjoy an exciting journey into space with the movie characters. One of my favorite movies is Interstellar by Christopher Nolan. Sometimes I wish I could travel in space in real life.

questions.question: Have you ever learnt about outer space and stars?
questions.answer: Yes, I have. Geography is a subject in China’s compulsory education, and astronomy interlinks with the geographical phenomena on earth. So basically, everyone will have to learn something about Cosmos and the stars. I know what planets compose the solar system and how the moon would affect the tide. questions.answer: These days, loads of people use their phones to remember stuff, and it makes sense because phones are super handy. They're like a part of our brain, but outside our body, holding tons of info easily. Phones have all these features – reminders, calendars, note apps – that help you keep track of things without cramming everything in your head. It's a smart way to deal with the crazy amount of information we deal with every day.

questions.question: Are you good at memorizing things?
questions.answer: I'm pretty decent at remembering things, especially if it's something I'm really into. Linking new info to stuff I already know seems to help a lot. But, of course, I get forgetful sometimes, especially when I'm distracted or stressed out. In general, though, I'd say my memory's pretty reliable. Still, I do lean on things like notes and reminders as a backup.

questions.question: Have you ever forgotten something that was important?
questions.answer: Yeah, I've definitely forgotten important stuff before, and it's super annoying. Like this one time, I totally spaced on a big appointment because I was swamped and forgot to set a reminder. That was a tough way to learn how important it is to keep things organized and prioritize. Ever since then, I've been trying to stay on top of things better.

questions.question: What do you need to remember in your daily life?
questions.answer: Well, keeping a schedule is a big deal in my daily life. As a student, I have quite a lot of things going on with classes, club activities and competitions, and I rely heavily on my schedule to keep everything organized, such as when I have lectures, when I have study time, and when I have group activities. Another important thing is to remember to drink water and eat healthy even when I'm running around. I usually carry a water bottle and some healthy snacks with me to stay energized. Paying attention to these things helps me stay organized and take care of myself.

questions.question: Do you like taking photos?
questions.answer: Yes, I am a great fan of photography. I think the capability of the human brain is limited and we tend to forget or even neglect our experiences. But with a camera, we can capture and constantly refresh those wonderful memories. That’s why I’m keen on taking photos to snapshot those little moments of my life.

questions.question: Do you like taking selfies?
questions.answer: Yes, I do enjoy taking selfies. It's a fun way for me to capture moments and express myself. It allows me to document my experiences and share them with friends and family. Plus, it's a great way to boost my confidence and celebrate my individuality. The art of taking selfies has become quite popular nowadays with the rise of social media platforms. With the different filters and editing tools available, it's like having my own personal photographer. So yes, I like taking selfies, but I also value the importance of being present in the real world.

questions.question: Where do you like to go to take photos?
questions.answer: I personally enjoy capturing the charm of urban architecture. The blend of old and new buildings in cities fascinates me. Exploring the bustling streets, I find myself drawn to the intricate details of historical structures as well as the sleek lines of modern skyscrapers. Additionally, I love visiting museums and art galleries, as they offer unique subjects that tell stories through paintings, sculptures, and artifacts. Lastly, libraries provide a tranquil setting, allowing me to delve into my photography with a focus on the power of knowledge and the serenity it brings.

questions.question: What is your favourite family photo?
questions.answer: One of my favorite family photos is from New Year's Eve. It captures the joyous moment when we gather together, smiling and holding our glasses of champagne, ready to toast to the new year ahead. The photo symbolizes unity and celebration, reminding me of the importance of family bonds and the excitement of new beginnings.

questions.question: Do you like taking selfies?
questions.answer: To be honest, I don’t really like taking selfies. I can even count on one hand the number of selfies I've taken. It's not just because I think it's kind of ridiculous, but it's also that I really don't like how I look in pictures. Sometimes, if someone points a camera in my direction, I usually hide my face. I don't actually think I'm unattractive, but when I see myself in pictures, I can be horrified, you know? My eyes go beady, my mouth narrows, my nose expands, and those cheekbones I thought I had have gone. I start to wonder if the photos are actually more accurate. Also, when I meet a lot of people, I feel particularly camera-shy.

questions.question: What is your favorite family photo?
questions.answer: The family photo that I really like is one which was taken almost twenty years ago. It was framed and enlarged by my father back then, and it is still hanging on the wall of our drawing room. The photo was taken on my parents' 6th wedding anniversary, and at that time I was only three years old. In the picture, my dad, mom and I were standing there, while my grandparents were sitting in front of us, and the picture captured the memory of a happy family. When this picture was taken, I was very little, and I don’t have any recollection of it, but every time I see it, I feel a real sense of joy.

questions.question: Do you want to improve your picture taking skills?
questions.answer: Who wouldn’t? To reiterate, I’m a big fan of photography, but I have to admit that I’m only a layman. Whenever I see breathtaking photos captured by other photographers, I feel this urge inside of me to improve my mediocre photography skills. I hope in the future I can invest more time and money into learning the art.

questions.question: Which do you prefer, expensive shoes or comfortable shoes?
questions.answer: Well, definitely comfortable shoes. Honestly, why would anyone pick expensive shoes over comfortable ones? Unless it‘s for some commercial event, I guess. I‘m not super rich, so I really wouldn't go for the expensive ones. I think it‘s just a waste of money.

questions.question: How much money do you usually spend on shoes?
questions.answer: Well, I think those that cost 200 RMB or so are perfect. You know, for everyday use, that price is not too high or too low. I can afford them. Also, at that price, I can easily find shoes that are comfortable and durable.

questions.question: Have you ever bought shoes online?
questions.answer: I am a big fan of online shopping, however, shoes are one of the few things I don’t. buy online often. Shoes come in many shapes and styles but only very few look good on me. I did buy a pair recently from a European e-commerce website called Selfridges during the sales season. The price was great although they haven’t actually arrived yet so I hope they’ll fit!

questions.question: Do you know anything about growing plants?
questions.answer: Yeah, I know quite a bit about gardening. I know how to grow aloe vera(芦荟). The first step in growing aloe vera is to realize that this plant grows best in a dry environment. Aloe plants cannot tolerate standing water. Another important thing about caring for Aloe Vera potted plants is that they need proper light. Growing an aloe vera home pot plant is not only easy, but it also provides the family with a plant that helps treat minor burns and rashes.

questions.question: Do Chinese people send plants as gifts?
questions.answer: Yes, we do. In ancient China, a young man would use the peony as a gift to show his affection for a woman. When seeing someone off, a poet, scholar or official would pick up a willow branch and give it to the person who is leaving. Nowadays, influenced by western culture, people will send roses to express their love for others.

questions.question: Did you grow any plants when you were young?
questions.answer: Yes. When I was young, I used to have two kinds of potted plants in my home: an aloe plant and a peace lily. The gel of the aloe plant has a number of healing properties. Not only does it soothe skin burns and cuts, it can also help to monitor the air quality in your home. Also, the beautiful peace lily is a wonderful flower to keep in the home.

questions.question: Do you keep plants at home?
questions.answer: Yes, I do. Visually, plants make my home look more beautiful. They are the best decorations. Also, it’s not just about improving the indoor aesthetic. Even if I don’t normally notice a plant’s presence, knowing one is there can subconsciously make me feel calm and relaxed.

questions.question: Would you like to have more free time in the future?
questions.answer: Yes, I would definitely appreciate having more free time in the future. Having extra time would allow me to explore hobbies and activities that I am passionate about, such as painting and hiking. It would also provide me with the opportunity to spend quality time with my loved ones and enhance my overall well- being. More free time would undoubtedly contribute to a better work-life balance and promote self-care, ensuring a more fulfilling and rewarding lifestyle.

questions.question: Which day do you have more free time on, Saturday or Sunday?
questions.answer: On Saturdays, I typically have more free time to relax and enjoy various activities. I often use this day to catch up on reading, baking, or spending time outdoors. Sundays, on the other hand, I tend to devote to self-care, meditation, or meeting with friends. Overall, I find both days equally important for balancing work and leisure activities in my schedule.

questions.question: Do you often have free time?
questions.answer: As a person with a busy schedule, I treasure the limited free time I have. Balancing work and personal life can be challenging, but I make it a priority to indulge in my hobbies during my spare moments. I enjoy reading novels, exploring new cafes, and practicing yoga to unwind and recharge. Having some free time allows me to rejuvenate and focus better on my responsibilities.

questions.question: What do you and your family like to do in spare time?
questions.answer: We will go for a walk in the park together. Because there is a beautiful wetland part nearby a lake in my hometown. So strolling after dinner is like a great family activity for us. By the way, the scenery is beautiful and we can chat while walking.

questions.question: Do you think you will spend more time with your family?
questions.answer: I would like to spend more time with my family. Having quality time with family is important for everybody. However, as I grow up, I spend less and less time with my parents. My college is in a city far away from my hometown. I can only go home during summer and winter vacations.

questions.question: Do you like to spend time with your family?
questions.answer: Of course, I do. Nowhere is better than home, right? Since I am the only child in my family and I have a very close relationship with my parents. I always feel safe and warm when I am with my family. when I am with my family, I feel that I am complete.

questions.question: What do you usually do when you are free?
questions.answer: As a crazy traveler, I want to travel when I have a long holiday. You know it's fun to explore the nature and the world. It’s not unusual to become a bit bored of everyday life. The daily routine: bills to pay; shopping to do; a big project at work; meals to cook; clothes to wash …I look forward to some ‘time out’ each year. It’s a time to switch off from everything back home and to leave our worries behind.

questions.question: Do you mind if others borrow money from you?
questions.answer: I believe in helping others when needed. I don't mind lending money to friends or family if they are in genuine need. However, it's essential to set clear expectations for repayment to avoid any misunderstandings. Trust and communication are key in such situations to maintain healthy relationships.

questions.question: Have you ever borrowed books from others?
questions.answer: Yes, I have borrowed books from people in the past. From my memory, I borrowed some books about science and technology from one of my friends because I was very interested in those subjects but I didn’t have any related books. I think it’s a good way to learn from each other by lending and borrowing books, and it's also very convenient.

questions.question: Have you ever borrowed money from others?
questions.answer: Actually, I have borrowed money from others before. For example, last summer I borrowed 900 dollars from my father to buy a laptop, but I returned it soon after I got my salary from my internship. Frankly speaking, I don’t borrow money that often.

questions.question: Do you like to lend things to others?
questions.answer: Well, I don’t mind lending things to people although I’m not that keen on it because from my perspective I think it’s people’s responsibility to buy their own things and not always borrow things from others. You know, it’s very annoying when I can’t get my things back after I’ve lent them to others.

questions.question: How do you feel when people don’t return things they borrowed from you?
questions.answer: Well, I think it depends. If someone failed to return my belongings without any reason, I would feel disappointed and even angry at them, since they don’t respect promises. However, I can understand if they don’t return my items due to unavoidable circumstances and have explained them to me in advance.

questions.question: What kinds of news do you share with our friends?
questions.answer: I enjoy sharing a variety of news with my friends - from interesting articles about travel destinations and fashion trends, to updates on local events and heartwarming stories about people making a difference in the community. I also like sharing recipes, book recommendations, and fitness tips to inspire and bond with my friends over common interests. Sharing news is a way to connect and create meaningful conversations with those I care about.

questions.question: Who is the first person you like to share good news with?
questions.answer: The first person I would like to share good news with is definitely my close friend Jack. He's been my best buddy since childhood and has always been there for me through thick and thin. Whenever something exciting happens, he's the one I turn to for support and celebration. Sharing good news with Jack not only doubles the joy but also strengthens our bond as friends.

questions.question: Did your parents teach you to share when you were a child?
questions.answer: When I was little, my mom was the one who was always telling me to share things. She asked me to take out my toys when my childhood friends came, she also required me to retell what had happened in the kindergarten when I got back home. I believe my mom made a wise decision because sharing things, no matter material stuff or daily stories, is really helpful to maintain a good relationship with others.

questions.question: What kind of things do you like to share with others?
questions.answer: Actually, there are a lot of different kinds of stuff that I am willing to tell others, especially delightful things. When I pass an important test, I would tell my parents about it. When I see a hilarious story, I would recount it to my friends. Sharing, in my opinion, can double the happiness, so I always tell cheerful things.

questions.question: What kind of things are not suitable for sharing?
questions.answer: Privacy is something that I think is absolutely unsuitable for telling others. For the ones who tell the personal things, they may put themselves in danger if the listeners are not trustworthy enough. For the listeners, they may not want to bear those secret things. So, sharing personal stuff is not so responsible for both the tellers and the listeners.

questions.question: Do you have anything to share with others recently?
questions.answer: Well, recently I have been working on this IELTS examination, so the things that I would like to talk to my friends are usually about this exam. You know the reading and listening parts of IELTS are generally about some academic knowledge so I can always learn something from them. After reading or listening, I would share what I have known with other people.

questions.question: When was the last time you visited a museum?
questions.answer: It was during my last summer vacation. At the time there was a new museum in our city. It was a special one because it wasn’t about history, culture or science. Instead, it was about people who had broken up. In this museum. I saw many words and stories from these disheartened people, and I could really feel their disappointment and agony due to their breakups.

questions.question: Do you often visit museums?
questions.answer: Actually, I don't visit museums very often because all the museums are very far away from my home. And I'm quite busy with my studies, so I don't have much time to visit them. However, I still enjoy visiting them because I think they’re magical places where I can learn about our ancestors.

questions.question: Do you think museums are important?
questions.answer: Yes. I think museums are very important because one can learn many things there. When visiting museums, people can learn history, geography, culture, art, science, and so on. Nowadays, museums are becoming more and more interesting by holding many interactive activities and games to engage visitors. These special features are attractive as well as educational.

questions.question: Are there any museums in your hometown?
questions.answer: Yes, there are several well-known museums in my city. The most famous one is The Provincial Museum and there are numerous unique exhibits all year round, which people cannot enjoy in other places. Because of this, each year, tourists at home and abroad go to appreciate the artworks and ancient items in this museum.

questions.question: What are the most beautiful sights you have seen while travelling?
questions.answer: One of the most stunning sights I’ve witnessed was the Northern Lights in Iceland; their vibrant colors dancing across the night sky felt magical. Additionally, the serene cherry blossoms in Japan during spring create a breathtaking spectacle. These experiences showed me nature’s incredible artistry from very different perspectives.

questions.question: Do you like to take scenery pictures?
questions.answer: Yes, I enjoy capturing scenic photographs because they allow me to preserve beautiful moments in nature. For instance, during my last trip to the mountains, I took pictures of the sunrise that showcased stunning colors. It’s a relaxing hobby that also helps me see the world from different perspectives.

questions.question: Do you prefer the mountains or the sea?
questions.answer: Although both landscapes have their charm, I find the mountains more appealing. The fresh air and panoramic views offer a peaceful retreat from city life. For instance, hiking up a mountain trail allows me to connect with nature in a way the sea’s endless horizon doesn’t quite provide. This sense of adventure fascinates me.

questions.question: Do you look out the window at the scenery when travelling by bus or car?
questions.answer: Yes, I often find myself gazing out the window while traveling by bus or car. Observing the changing landscapes helps me relax and pass time. For instance, on a recent bus trip through the countryside, I enjoyed spotting various farms and wildlife, which made the journey more enjoyable and interesting.

questions.question: Do you like getting up early in the morning?
questions.answer: Honestly, waking up early isn’t my favorite thing because I’m more of a night owl. However, on days when I have important tasks, getting up early helps me feel more productive and energized. Sometimes, the quiet morning hours allow me to enjoy a peaceful start before the day gets busy. Overall, I appreciate early mornings occasionally but not every day.

questions.question: What do you usually do in the morning?
questions.answer: In the mornings, I typically start by stretching to wake my body up, then enjoy a cup of green tea while reading the news. Sometimes, I go for a jog in the nearby park to energize myself. This routine helps me feel refreshed and ready to tackle the day ahead with focus and enthusiasm.

questions.question: What did you do in the morning when you were little? Why?
questions.answer: When I was little, my mornings usually began with a family breakfast because my parents believed it was important to start the day together. After eating, I often played outside with my friends to enjoy the fresh air and sunshine before school. This routine helped me feel energized and happy throughout the day.

questions.question: Are there any differences between what you do in the morning now and what you did in the past?
questions.answer: Certainly! Compared to the past, my morning routine has changed quite a bit. Previously, I used to rush through breakfast, but now I take time to prepare a healthy meal. Also, I’ve started doing some light exercise, which energizes me for the day ahead. These small adjustments have made my mornings more enjoyable and productive. 5. Do you spend your mornings doing the same things on both weekends and weekdays? Why or why not? What I do on weekend mornings is different from what I do in the mornings during the week. You know, as a student, I’m often quite busy on weekday mornings, getting dressed, getting my backpack ready, having breakfast and so on. But on the weekend, I like to have relaxed mornings, like going for a run or visiting the library. What I do on weekend mornings is different from what I do in the mornings during the week. I'm still a student, so Monday to Friday mornings I get up at 7 am to go to class. But I don't have classes on weekends, so I don't need to get up early. Usually I go for a run on Saturdays, and then I spend the rest of the morning in the library. On Sundays, I usually sleep in late.

questions.question: Do you think people are happy when buying new things?
questions.answer: Why not? In most cases, buying new things is joyful because it means we are able to afford the things we want to purchase. But things would be very different if we were buying a new house because that means we have loans to pay, and that could be quite stressful.

questions.question: Do you feel happy when buying new things?
questions.answer: Definitely. Who doesn’t? I think most people love shopping because it means we are able to afford the things we want, and it’s a really joyful journey. New shoes, new iPhones, new outfits, I’m even happy right now imagining getting all those new things .

questions.question: When do you feel happy at work? Why?
questions.answer: I would really be happy if I make some achievements at work. I like challenging things and don’t wanna do routine work only. So, whenever I get out of my comfort zone and face challenges at work, I feel very thrilled and will become even happier when I handle the challenges smoothly.

questions.question: Is there anything that has made you feel happy lately?
questions.answer: Yes, I just enjoyed my Chinese New Year vacation with my family and friends, and I was super happy. See, we have a whole week off for the holiday. For the first couple of days, I spent some quality time with my family members, sitting down, chatting, and having family dinners. Later , I went traveling with my family to Hangzhou and spent a really nice time there.

questions.question: What do you think will make you feel happy in the future?
questions.answer: Many things can make me feel happy in the future. Because of the Covid-19 pandemic in the past three years, I feel that being healthy is important, so I have decided to start some workouts like going jogging, and I believe regular exercises will make me much stronger and feel refreshed and energetic as well. In addition, now countries around the world are relaxing mask mandates and I’m really looking forward to going traveling abroad next year, and I feel kinda thrilled as I’m thinking of this.

questions.question: What made you happy when you were little?
questions.answer: There were lots of things that made me feel happy when I was young. For example, when I got my favorite dolls or toys on my birthday, I would be over the moon. Sometimes, I got good grades in math, I also felt really happy because I was not good at math. Apart from that, when I spent my summer vacation in the countryside with my grandparents and hung out with my friends in the village, I also had a lot of fun. As you can see, I had a very happy childhood.
